# S48 — Raise compile and target SDK to the current Play requirement

**Findings:** app/build.gradle:14,19 (compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34) · **Size:** S · **Tree:** release

**2026-10-04** — Play requirement checked 2026-10-04 at https://developer.android.com/google/play/requirements/target-sdk: since 2026-08-31, new apps and app updates must target API 36 (Android 16); existing apps must target 35+ to stay available to new users on newer devices. Target set to 36.

**2026-10-04** — Walkthrough 2026-10-04, debug build targetSdk=36 (dumpsys confirmed), AVDs s48_pixel6_api36 and s48_tablet_api36 (system-images;android-36;google_apis;arm64-v8a), driven via adb + uiautomator. Passed: edge-to-edge (top bar below status bar, FAB above gesture bar on dashboard, settings, detail); notification permission dialog -> POST_NOTIFICATIONS granted; reminder set 10:46 fired, notification posted on channel tracker_reminders by 10:47:41; back gesture settings->dashboard, detail->dashboard, dashboard->launcher; backup Save to file (valid JSON) and Import with preview + Replace, reminder alarm kept after import; Pixel Tablet landscape, portrait and split screen with Settings, same process, no crash. Not verified: the predictive back animation visually (adb swipes only); Archived screen (S15 not merged). Pre-existing, not caused by the bump (same on a targetSdk 34 build): with the keyboard open the tracker dialog's Save row sits partly behind the IME; Settings still shows 'Allow notifications' after granting (S09). gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleRelease: exit 0; lint at target 36 only drops OldTargetApi vs target 34, no new issues; tools:targetApi left unchanged.

**Not in this slice:** upgrading Kotlin, Compose or AGP beyond what the SDK bump forces, and new features.

## Why

Google Play only accepts new apps and updates targeting a recent API level. The requirement changes every year, so it must be looked up when releasing.

## Files

- `app/build.gradle`
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` (`tools:targetApi`)
- `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
- `DEVELOPERS.md` ("Requirements" section)

## Failing tests

- None. The existing tests and a device walkthrough are the check.

## Implement

1. Look up Google Play's current target API requirement in the Play Console help or the Android developer documentation, for new apps and for updates. Record the source and the value with `slicer note S48`. (The earlier note in this roadmap says at least API 35 for new apps since August 2025. Confirm it rather than trusting that.)
2. Set `targetSdk` to that level, and `compileSdk` too if S53 left it lower. Install the matching SDK platform. Update the "Android SDK 34" lines in `DEVELOPERS.md` and `BUILDING.md`.
3. If the new `compileSdk` allows it, `androidx.core:core-ktx` may move to the version in the catalog. Otherwise leave it.
4. Re-test on an emulator at that API level:
   - Edge-to-edge is enforced from API 35: no content may sit under the status or navigation bars, and the Scaffold insets must apply.
   - Notification permission and a delivered reminder.
   - The predictive back gesture from the detail and settings screens (needs S10).
   - Backup export and import.
   - If the target is API 36: predictive back is on by default (check the back animation from every screen, including the Archived screen from S15), and on large screens (sw600dp and up) Android ignores orientation and resizability restrictions, so run the app on a Pixel Tablet emulator in both orientations and in split screen.
5. Fix only what the bump breaks.
